question: How many customers are in the database?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers;

question: How many customers are located in Europe?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS europe_customers FROM customers WHERE region = 'Europe';

question: List all Hardware products sorted by unit price from highest to lowest.
golden_sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products WHERE category = 'Hardware' ORDER BY unit_price DESC, product_id ASC;

question: What is the average unit price of Software products?
golden_sql: SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price FROM products WHERE category = 'Software';

question: How many orders have a quantity of at least 8?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_quantity_orders FROM orders WHERE quantity >= 8;

question: What is the total revenue across all orders?
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders;

question: What are the top 5 most expensive products by unit price?
golden_sql: SELECT product_name, category, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC, product_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: Show the number of customers in each region.
golden_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY region;

question: Show total revenue by customer region.
golden_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region;

question: Show total revenue by product category.
golden_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(o.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category;

question: What are the top 5 products by total revenue?
golden_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(o.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total revenue?
golden_sql: SELECT c.company_name, SUM(o.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 5;

question: How many distinct customers have purchased Hardware products?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS hardware_customers FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Hardware';

question: What is the total quantity ordered per product category by customers in Asia?
golden_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(o.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.region = 'Asia' GROUP BY p.category;

question: Which customer regions generated more than 50000 in total revenue?
golden_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region HAVING SUM(o.revenue) > 50000;

question: List product categories whose average order revenue exceeds 1000.
golden_sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(o.revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category HAVING AVG(o.revenue) > 1000;

question: Show total revenue and order count for each customer region.
golden_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region;

question: Which customers placed more than 5 orders?
golden_sql: SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 5;

question: Show monthly revenue totals across 2024 ordered chronologically.
golden_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(revenue) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month ASC;
sqlite_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) ORDER BY month ASC;

question: Using a CTE, find customers whose total spending exceeds the average total spending per customer.
golden_sql: WITH customer_spend AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, SUM(o.revenue) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name) SELECT company_name, total_spend FROM customer_spend WHERE total_spend > (SELECT AVG(total_spend) FROM customer_spend);

question: Rank products within each category by total revenue and return the top 2 per category.
golden_sql: WITH prod_rev AS (SELECT p.category, p.product_name, SUM(o.revenue) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.revenue) DESC) AS rev_rank FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category, p.product_id, p.product_name) SELECT category, product_name, total_revenue, rev_rank FROM prod_rev WHERE rev_rank <= 2 ORDER BY category ASC, rev_rank ASC;

question: Calculate monthly revenue and running cumulative revenue over 2024.
golden_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(revenue) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM')) SELECT month, monthly_revenue, SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_revenue FROM monthly ORDER BY month ASC;
sqlite_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date)) SELECT month, monthly_revenue, SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_revenue FROM monthly ORDER BY month ASC;

question: Show quarterly order counts for 2024.
golden_sql: WITH qtrs AS (SELECT CONCAT('Q', EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date)::INT) AS quarter, order_id FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01') SELECT quarter, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM qtrs GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter ASC;
sqlite_sql: WITH qtrs AS (SELECT 'Q' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1) AS quarter, order_id FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01') SELECT quarter, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM qtrs GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter ASC;
